_comment: Who writes which file. scripts/layer_audit.py checks this against the
code (an AST walk over scripts/) and fails on any drift: an undeclared
writer, a stale declaration, a shared file or a layer crossing with no
reason, or a seed row whose `source` no writer owns. Ported from
Layers follow what a file is a record OF, except that anything derived,
regenerated every run and never hand-edited is `derived`, whichever
layer it summarizes. Patterns are matched in order; put specific paths

layers.raw: Fetched source copies and the fetch and parse state around them.
layers.review: Candidates awaiting a reviewer. Reviewers edit these by hand.
layers.seed: Records of record. Hand-reviewed or rebuilt from a named source; the build reads only these.
layers.derived: Regenerated outputs: the published data, its manifest and audits.
layers.reference: Copied from pricephillips/data-center-map with an attribution line. No script here writes it; its writer is named under copied_from.

data/reference/data_center_events.csv.reason: Local data center events copied from pricephillips/data-center-map master_opposition.csv (path from --dc-map or $RO_DATA_CENTER_MAP), placed by classify.county_fips_all. Read by site_profile.py and group_registry.py; never part of the renewable counts.

data/reference/facilities.csv.reason: Solar, wind, storage and geothermal plants from EIA-860M, USWTDB and USPVDB (public domain), one row per plant and status. The source files are not committed (the EIA workbook is about 14 MB a month); facilities_manifest.csv records each one's URL, release and SHA-256. Read by build_seed_outputs.py through scripts/facility_matches.py.

data/geo/*.copied_from: pricephillips/data-center-map data/geo/ (acquire-geo-sources.yml, boundaries job); see data/geo/README.md

data/review/queue.csv.reason: parse.py appends new candidates; promote_reviewed.py only sets review_status on rows it promotes.

data/review/cases_candidates.csv.reason: build_sabin_seeds.py regenerates the candidate rows and carries reviewer columns forward (merge_candidates); promote_reviewed.py only sets review_status on rows it promotes.

data/review/sabin_edition_worklist.csv.reason: 2025 Sabin records missing from the September 2026 edition or ambiguous in the crosswalk, and the 2026 entries held with them. Regenerated with the Sabin seeds, which the data workflow does not run, so it is committed.

data/review/sabin_edition_crosswalk.csv.reason: Maps each 2025 REC- id onto its September 2026 entry. The script regenerates the match columns and carries the reviewer columns (review_decision, reviewer, reviewed_on, review_note) forward.

data/renewable_opposition_records_2026-0.reason: The Sabin Center September 2026 edition, extracted from its stored export and web edition (data/raw/) in the columns of data/renewable_opposition_records.csv. Read by sabin_crosswalk.py and build_sabin_seeds.py.

data/review/place_overrides.csv.reason: A reviewer's county for a record the code cannot place, with an evidence URL. build_seed_outputs.py applies it last (resolutions.apply_place_overrides).

data/review/local_knowledge.csv.reason: What local contacts, meetings and documents report about a county, unverified. Not in this public repository: it lives at $RO_LOCAL_KNOWLEDGE (default ~/.renewable-opposition/local_knowledge.csv), this path is gitignored, and scripts/precommit_gates.py private refuses any staged local_knowledge* file. Declared so that only site_profile.py may name it; it reads the file only without --no-local, and the build must not read or publish it (tests/test_local_knowledge.py).

data/review/negative_checks.csv.reason: A reviewer's 'checked, nothing found' result for a county, with what was searched. build_seed_outputs.py validates it (scripts/negative_checks.py) and site_profile.py prints it; never published as a record.

data/review/group_candidates.csv.reason: Opposition groups named in the seeds' or Sabin text, one per row, awaiting a news URL that was opened (group_source_url, access). group_registry.py publishes a group only once that is filled; until then it is held in data/review/group_review.csv.

data/seed/restrictions_seed.csv.reason: Each writer owns its rows by `source` and keeps every other row as it found it.

data/review/state_policies_candidates.cs.reason: State siting law rows, drafted against the statute and reviewed by someone other than the drafter (docs/AGENT_REVIEW.md). build_seed_outputs.py publishes reviewed rows (scripts/state_policies.py) and holds the rest in data/processed/state_policies_held.csv.

data/review/sabin_state_level_dispositio.reason: What became of each state-level Sabin row held for a statute check: the state_policies row that covers it, or why it stays held.

data/review/nrel_restriction_conflicts.c.reason: NREL restrictions matched to a Sabin, Moratorium Nation or review-queue restriction for the same jurisdiction and technology: duplicates (not published twice) and conflicts (both kept, to review). Regenerated with the NREL seed rows, which the data workflow does not run, so it is committed.

data/review/nrel_sample.csv.reason: The fixed-seed random sample of NREL restrictions checked against their ordinances (scripts/nrel_sample.py draw).

data/review/nrel_sample_review.csv.reason: A reviewing agent's verdict on each sampled NREL feature against the ordinance (docs/AGENT_REVIEW.md). Read by nrel_sample.py and siting_standards.py.

data/review/restriction_sources.csv.reason: Hand-edited by reviewers; nrel_sample.py apply only appends a confirmed row for an NREL sample instrument whose every sampled feature a reviewer confirmed against the ordinance.

data/review/ohio_sb52_worklist.csv.reason: One row per Ohio county for SB 52 restricted-area checks, with the records already held. A worklist the data workflow does not regenerate, so it is committed.

data/seed/contested_projects_seed.csv.reason: Each writer owns its rows by `source` and keeps every other row as it found it.

crossings.scripts/parse.py: Records what it parsed (raw) and queues what it found (review).
crossings.scripts/build_sabin_seeds.py: Rebuilds Sabin seed rows and holds back the rows that need a reviewer.
crossings.scripts/extract_sabin_edition.py: Writes the edition's extraction (seed) and its count reconciliation (derived).
crossings.scripts/nrel_ordinances.py: Writes NREL's restriction rows (seed) and the conflicts they raise with other sources (review).
crossings.scripts/nrel_sample.py: Draws the accuracy sample and records passing instruments (review), and reports the error rates (derived).
crossings.scripts/promote_reviewed.py: The gated step from review to seed; marks each promoted row.

scripts/promote_reviewed.py.reason: Writes the seed named by SEED_FOR for each promoted entity type.

scripts/source_archive.py.reason: os.path paths passed as run() defaults; writes via a .tmp then os.replace. Its selftest writes only to a temp dir.

scripts/build_seed_outputs.py.reason: state_policies.HELD_PATH and facility_matches.WORKLIST_PATH, module constants of scripts/state_policies.py and scripts/facility_matches.py.

scripts/run_pipeline.py.reason: --summary appends stage output to a file outside the repository ($GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY in Actions); it owns no data. Every data file is written by the stage scripts it runs.

scripts/site_profile.py.reason: --out writes a report to a path the user names, never a repository data file. Its one repository write is data/review/profile_requests.csv (declared above).

exempt.scripts/precommit_gates.py: Rewrites staged files' line endings (csv-lf --fix) and temp files in its selftest; owns no data.
